items.text: We are releasing this Quick Fix to address the issue reported to us by the community. Selecting the "Later" option in some dialogues could have resulted in some parts of the content becoming unavailable to players. This issue is fixed now, and the fix should work on your existing saves.
Fixed some parts of the content (cookhouses, farms, barns) becoming unavailable after selecting the "Later" dialogue option in their corresponding radio transmissions.
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

We are bringing a new batch of fixes your way. This will probably be the last bugfix update for quite some time, as we want to fully focus on the development of Major Update #7. More info on this update should come your way soon. Thank you for playing Infection Free Zone!
Updated farms to allow placement on steeper terrain, making previously inaccessible locations available.
Improved the efficiency of map rendering during the Map Selection process.
Fixed an issue causing repeated "Horde spotted" radio messages when hordes repeatedly entered and left the Fog of War.
Fixed an issue where merchant transmissions would not end if the merchant was killed during the transmission.
Fixed an issue where swarm attacks were sometimes missing in games launched via Convoys.
Fixed an issue where some enemy groups respawning from Lairs were unable to exit buildings.

Fixed an issue where workers could get stuck in an infinite loop when a Warehouse was full under certain edge cases. Warehouses can now also hold up to 10 extra units of a resource to prevent overstocking issues.
Fixed errors that occurred when planting explosives beneath buildings that had already been removed.
Fixed errors that occurred when initiating an exchange between a Squad and a Warehouse.
Fixed an issue causing FPS drops during Purifier attacks.
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

We keep on working hard on Major Update #7. Hopefully, we can share the first preview with you somewhere soon. In the meantime, we deliver a fresh batch of bug fixes your way, including a fix for the most common issue with incorrect messages about server responses being modified by the internet provider.
Updated Alpha Infected Icon and Event Icons.
Rebalanced damage distribution in Lairs and Hideouts to make the spread of enemy damage more even. Now all Squads should receive damage, not only one.
Fixed the "Server responses seem to be modified by your internet provider" message appearing on start-up when it shouldn't.
Fixed Squads deciding to wear Armor, despite telling them to use None during the Squad Creation.
Fixed some incorrect Camera behavior when zooming in and out on the Map Overview.
Fixed Hideout markers sometimes not disappearing despite destroying the Hideout.
Fixed some rare errors that could have occurred during scavenging.
Fixed some rare crashes caused by tree generation.
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

We’re happy to let you know that another bugfix update has just been released! While optimization and bug fixing remain our main focus, we’ve also decided to introduce a few changes that have been highly requested by the community. We hope you’ll enjoy them!

Added Game's End Pop-up and optional Credits after dealing with the Purifier Zone (late-game gameplay with Convoys). Many players asked us for a formal ending to the game. Of course, the game can be continued after that.
Updated the Driver's behavior. The Driver will now shoot along with the rest of the Squad while the Vehicle is standing still.
Updated grass optimization across the game. This also includes some heavy fixes, where the grass was rendered even though it wasn't visible to the players at all.

Lowered the building space requirement for the Gathering Place building. For comparison, the biggest Gathering Place (for 2,000 citizens) now requires 33,000 m^3 of space, compared to 50,000 m^3 that it previously required.
Fixed Squad sometimes becoming unresponsive after an exchange with another Squad.
Fixed autosaves sometimes taking too long due to volumetric fog.
Fixed missing Farm highlight when the cursor hovered over the middle of the Farm.
Fixed Buildings' Full Info mode not displaying correctly after starting a repair.
Fixed errors when a structure connected to plant explosives work was destroyed or unavailable.
Fixed the Expedition Tiles with Scientists sometimes providing the player with an enormous amount of resources.
Fixed another batch of different issues that could've impacted stability or caused crashes.

Other than this update, we’re also slowly working towards the first part of the Major Update #7 Preview announcement. We can’t wait to show you all the cool things we’ve been working on! The first part of the preview should be ready within the next few weeks. Do you have any guesses about what we might be adding to the game?
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

We are happy to bring a new Bugfix Update #42 your way! In addition to several fixes, we’re also updating two important systems. The Citizen Panel now includes a “MAX” button and should be easier to manage. And large buildings now provide a significantly greater amount of loot. We can’t wait to see how you react to these changes. Have fun!
Updated the resource cap for large buildings. Scavenging bigger buildings should now be much more viable.
Updated priority management in the Citizen Panel. A new “MAX” button has been added, and the panel has been reorganized to improve usability.
Updated priority colors in Full Info Mode.
Updated the AddWorkersToHQ command to allow up to 1000 workers at once. Higher values previously caused crashes.
Updated farm efficiency based on temperature.
Fixed an issue where area scavenging would sometimes not select an area if SHIFT and LMB were released at the same time.
Fixed entrances to Custom Buildings sometimes spawning underground.
Fixed Full Info Mode icons appearing for NPC Zones.
Fixed Full Info Mode icons overlapping each other. We are still working on improving their visibility.
Fixed Street Names sometimes displaying over Squad Icons and other more important UI elements.
Fixed the meat production icon incorrectly appearing over the Medbay building.
Fixed some event markers that could spawn too high for the player to reach.
Fixed an error occurring when repairing buildings before placing the HQ on convoys.
Fixed cases of random “no path” icons appearing over buildings. While we hope this resolves all similar cases, we will continue monitoring the issue.
Fixed inconsistencies in living quarters and capacity numbers when selecting the HQ and during gameplay.
Fixed Purifier HQ becoming uncaptured after save/load.
Fixed errors appearing when attacking Purifiers in Purifier Zones from inside buildings.
Fixed priorities not updating when adding resources via console commands.
Fixed squads spawning with pistols despite selecting machetes in the creation panel.
Fixed issues with manually planted tree regrowth.
Fixed incorrect farm colors in Farming NPC Zones.
Fixed towers and gates using metal not generating scrap.
Fixed farms and greenhouses sometimes being difficult to select.
Introduced another batch of stability improvements aimed at enhancing performance and reducing crashes.
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

This time we are releasing a small quick fix for an important issue. We have noticed that less than 0,5% of players encounter an issue that can result in some of their saves being unplayable. This quick fix should solve it and make them playable again. Have fun!
Fixed some saves not loading due to incorrect data about repair states.
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

We continue fixing the issues that you report to us. This time we are also introducing some small balance updates. Swarms should scale better towards the end-game now and the Infected Dogs were made a bit slower. Don't worry, they can still catch up to your slowest Vehicles, so you have to remain attentive to them. But their previous iteration was certainly overtuned.

Due to popular demand, we are also showing entrances to the buildings now when you select them. This should help you with Zone planning and ensuring that your Squads have proper access to all the buildings in the Zone.
Added Entrance indicators when selecting Buildings.
Reduced the Infected Dogs' movement speed from 70 to 50.
Updated the spawning of the Military Zones, so they can appear more frequently in all games, regardless of the chosen location.
Updated the swarms balance and scaling mechanics. Previously, the swarms could have been smaller if the player decided not to build walls, which wasn't intended behavior.

Fixed the vehicle spawning algorithm to ensure that every vehicle spawned on the map has a valid path from the chosen HQ. This should prevent situations where vehicles were spawned in places like courtyards.
Fixed Growling Caller to also end properly on older saves.
Fixed issues with the "Join us" option when encountering Neutral Zone on Expeditions.
Fixed tanks being able to hurt your own Squads when fighting on Expeditions.
Fixed the Mission panel by reducing its active clickable area. Previously, it was too easy to click on the Mission panel when doing other activities.
Fixed some cases of the Squads sometimes ignoring the attack order.
Fixed Meeting Point mission not ending properly upon fight with the hordes.
Fixed Squads not picking up items on Expeditions if they had their equipment slots full (despite free slots in the Vehicle's inventory).
Fixed some Squads sometimes deciding not to move when selecting and moving together as a larger group of Squads.
Fixed the possibility of placing the Walls over the building's entrances and locking your citizens in this way.
Fixed the resource tooltips sometimes closing down when not intended.
Fixed blurry ammo bar on High or below graphic settings.
Fixed grenades sometimes not exploding when thrown at steep terrain.
Fixed minefields requiring very flat surfaces to be placed.
Fixed rare cases of swarms stopping their attacks towards the late game.
Fixed some cases of trees not growing back.
Fixed custom buildings disappearing on high zoom-out.
Fixed hideout events to occur even with no proper buildings being present on the map.
Fixed issues with selecting vehicles when clicking on their icons.
Fixed vehicles sometimes spawning too close to HQ.
Fixed the missing chapter at the beginning of the game.
Fixed event markers sometimes spawning in incorrect places.
Fixed constructions sometimes ending without all required resources.
Fixed APC armor sometimes displaying in white.
Fixed the vaccine trial event not ending properly when more than 2 squads remain on the expedition tile.
Fixed some cases of the game loading getting stuck at 95%.
Fixed issues with planting trees in places where trees were previously planted.
Fixed closing the transmission log causing the game to unpause.
Fixed some repair works cancelling upon game load.
Fixed duplicated Emblems for some Supporter Pack users causing errors within the game.
Fixed some other stability issues and events that were not proceeding as intended.

We hope that this update will make your gameplay more stable. Other than that, we continue to review all your reports and feedback. Some issues are very hard to replicate or fix, but the more data we have, the easier it is. That's why we appreciate all the issues that you report to us through the Bug Reporter. Have fun!
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

This bugfix update took us a little bit longer than we hoped. But it was important for us to fix as many critical bugs as possible. You should find Infection Free Zone more stable after this update. Whether we are talking about quests, worker management, performance, or crashes. All those areas should see noticeable improvements.

But of course, we keep on analyzing all the feedback and bug reports. We will do our best to improve the Infection Free Zone even further. Thank you for playing our game and showing that you care about it!
Other than fixing bugs related to Worker Management systems, we have decided to change the location of the whole Dropdown Menu. The settings weren't the proper place for two reasons:
It was easy to miss when starting a new game,
The settings are global and affect all your games.

That's why we have moved it to Game Customization, where it fits way better. It only affects the current save now (so you can have different worker management systems across different games). And it can still be changed in the middle of the game. To do so, you have to:
Go to the Escape Menu.
Select "Customize" from the list.
Change the worker management system from the dropdown menu.
The new Priority system still remains optional. You can use the previous Manual system if you find it more comfortable to use.
Added a new transmission that informs about the option of using an Alarm.
Added ammo to the tank that can be found on convoys.
Updated the translations and some text descriptions.
Updated pop-up for Unsupported Saves and added "Read More" button redirecting to a Steam Guide.
Updated the Worker Assignment System and moved it from Settings to the Game Customization window.
Updated the Tooltips in the Priority Panels to display more detailed info about MAX Workers.
Updated the animation of the Transmission Panel warnings.
Updated the building demolition algorithms upon the game start. The demolished buildings are going to be different now, when starting a new game on the same map repeatedly.
Decreased the number of workers needed to repair the vehicle by 50% and slightly reduced the time needed for the vehicle repair.

Disabled the Alarm feature when playing with the Manual Worker Assignment System. It will come back, but this feature requires further improvements before that happens. It's still available with the Priority System.
Fixed Workers not remembering the priority of the Forrester Hut, Sawmill, and Repairmen Shop buildings after Save/Load.
Fixed incorrect Max Workers values when switching from Priority to Manual system.
Fixed an incorrect Workers Management system when loading older saves.
Fixes incorrect Worker numbers when loading older saves.
Fixed alerts about modded games appearing after a crash, even with no mods present.
Fixed missing parameters from new Research descriptions.
Fixed mission markers sometimes appearing on destroyed buildings.
Fixed some issues with the flow of reclaiming the Purifier Zone.
Fixed Squads sometimes not entering buildings when clicking on their corresponding marker icons.
Fixed Farms with irregular outline shapes after save/load.
Fixed some icons having incorrect positions in the panels.
Fixed some save files not loading up after migrating with Convoys.

Fixed the Growling Caller mission not ending properly. Still, this mission might remain stuck on older saves. If you really want to get rid of it, you can open the console commands with "~" and type "EnableCheats" followed by "CompleteActiveMissions". This should conclude all the active missions.
Fixed APC not using the Machine Gun properly at close range.
Fixed Squads receiving damage from Explosives when staying in buildings, despite Friendly Fire turned off.
Fixed the animal hunting mission not updating properly when running over the animals.
Fixed some rare occurrences of buildings with unique geometry missing entrances.
Fixed all the explosives to have a tradable value for the Merchant.
Fixed some of the new weapons and active items, like grenades, mines, and mortars, to have a dismantling value.
Fixed potential errors caused by minefields.
Fixed some weapons showing incorrect % damage falloff modifier with Squads that had a sharpshooter perk.
Introduced a set of stability changes that should reduce the number of crashes and exceptions occurring in the game.

By the way, we have also recently updated the Map Editor tool. It should now allow the modification of the 5x5 maps. Let us know how it works for you! Have fun, Survivors! Thank you once again for playing our game and helping us improve it.
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team
Another batch of fixes has arrived! We have also made yet another update to the Convoys to fix the situation where it was very easy to get stuck with no Storage space in the Bus HQ.
Increased Bus HQ Capacity after setting it up on Convoys from 60 to 300.
Updated the server settings.
Updated the analytics events.
Fixed a bug where the recent new Server in Singapore could have been unavailable.
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

We are coming with another Bugfix Update! This time we have focused on some much-requested balance changes, fixing convoys and adding a new server. We keep observing the most common issues and do our best to fix them over time. Thank you for all your bug reports!
Added a new server in Singapore. When downloading a new map, the game will verify which server works best and switch to it.
Added some starting resources to Vehicles in games started with Convoy.
Removed an option to start a new game with Terrain Elevation disabled.
Rebalanced the time needed to cut a tree. The time needed to cut a tree has been reduced by 30%.

Rebalanced the Infected Dogs. Their movement speed has been increased by 100%, while their damage was reduced by 50%. This should also make the Dog Lairs easier to defeat (they were vastly harder than Lairs with Infected Humans before).
Updated the game to auto-detect the default graphics quality better when starting the game for the first time or resetting the settings.
Fixed a bug that allowed placing towers in locations that should be unavailable.
Fixed a bug that resulted in the game setting the ultra graphic settings upon settings reset.
Fixed changing the "custom" level from the dropdown not working when changing the quality level in a language other than English.
Fixed a bug where starting a new game with Convoys was not available.
Fixed the missing food in games started with Convoy.
Fixed the disabled Research Center in games started with Convoy.
Fixed another batch of issues that could've resulted in getting stuck in the Scientists storyline or the storyline starting with a noticeable delay.
Fixed another batch of issues that could've resulted in the game crashing or decreased stability.

Are you waiting for the Major Update #6? We have some good news! We will do our best to deliver the next Major Update Preview next week. Expect a nice lecture about exciting new changes coming to the Infection Free Zone. The team is working hard to deliver substantial improvements that should vastly reduce micromanagement, among others.
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

Due to popular demand, we have started experimenting with the free camera console command. While this feature is highly experimental, we are adding it to this build. Please let us know how it works for you. Some issues can occur, but we hope to fix them over time.
Other than that, this build includes some other fixes and stability updates, which should positively impact your gameplay.

Added a free camera console command. Use EnableFreeCameraMode and DisableFreeCameraMode console commands to enable/disable this feature. Warning - this feature is highly experimental and can cause some issues. We will appreciate reporting all the encountered issues via the in-game Bug Reporter so we can fix them over time.

Added a pop-up for players from Russia who encounter issues when connecting to our servers. Players from Russia also shouldn't encounter endless loading anymore. When the game detects server issues, that player will be returned to the Main Menu.
Added European Union Flag to the Supporter Pack, as per community request.
Updated the Spanish translations to include changes suggested by the community.
Fixed the issue with split buildings changing shape and size upon save/load.
Fixed the issue with citizens sometimes running away from HQ towards the enemy Hideout.
Fixed one more Memory Leak that we were able to locate.
Fixed one more issue that could result in the game crashing for the players.
If you want to use the Free Camera and haven't used console commands before, here is a quick instruction:
Press the "~" button to open the console.
Type "EnableCheats".
Type "EnableFreeCameraMode".
Use RMB to start rotating your camera without any limitations.
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

A new Bugfix Update for Infection Free Zone has just been released. It mostly focuses on stability and fixing some commonly reported issues. The translations have been updated, and we have refreshed our Road Map, as the information in there wasn't up to date.
Added new Desktop Game Icon with transparent background.
Added a new tutorial event that launches when encountering swimming infected for the first time.
Updated the Road Map in the Main Menu.
Updated the game's logic when encountering issues with the navigation. The game will now return to the Main Menu and require a reload.
Updated translations in the game.
Fixed issues with flying buildings on some maps.
Fixed issue with flying Giza pyramids.
Fixed issues occurring when navigating through Map Selector.
Fixed replenishing squad members causing the Squad's custom name to change.
Fixed tile border lines displaying on some recommended maps.
Fixed handling exceptions in save files.
Introduced another set of optimization and stability changes aimed at improving the game's performance.

Thank you for playing Infection Free Zone! We know that it's a little bit overdue, but we also want to share a new Major Update preview with you soon. A little bit more patience will be extremely appreciated, as we still update some videos and screenshots that showcase new, exciting content coming your way.
Have fun!
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

Long time no see! The whole Jutsu Games team has been back at work for some time now, and we are working on new updates for you. The newest Bugfix Update #34 solves issues that were reported our way the most often. Thank you for all the reports!
Added additional tooltip information when trying to place a building in an unavailable area. The reason why this specific area is unavailable will now be visible to the player.
Fixed the missing Wallpapers for the owners of the Supporter Pack.
Fixed the Biohazard Case mission getting stuck at the "Kill hordes in the lab. (x/4)" objective.
Fixed the moving camera when opening the console command panel.
Fixed the issues occurring when selecting a playable map.
Fixed the issues occurring when using ENTER/ESC buttons for confirming and canceling actions.
Fixed a memory leak that negatively impacted the game's performance.

While we have already started working on the Major Update #6, it's still too early to share all the content of this update with you. We are exploring some ideas, adding some things, removing some, too. Once we have established the final content of this update, we will bring the appropriate announcement to you.
Best wishes to our whole community for 2026! Have fun!
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team
This quick fix solves the issue with vehicles burning more fuel than intended.
Fixed Fuel being used up way faster by Vehicles than intended.
Updated the Map visuals when selecting a starting area and on zoom-out to include the latest OSM data. Starting Area statistics data (number of buildings, etc.) were updated, too.
Updated the POIs to have a lesser impact on the game's performance.
Best regards,
Jutsu Games

A new build has just been released for everyone to play. It includes important fixes for excessive medieval walls spawned in the same locations and for the unselectable vehicles. We have also made some minor visual improvements. Have fun!
Updated the ESC and ENTER buttons usage across different parts of the UI. ESC and ENTER will cancel/confirm some actions, respectively.
Updated the swimming animation of the infected.
Updated refuelling action so it's also available when driving and increased refueling speed x3.
Updated the visibility of the vehicle's construction/deconstruction progress bar.
Fixed issue with medieval walls generating on top of each other and respawning upon save/load.
Fixed issues with some vehicles becoming unselectable.
Fixed APC not providing metal resource upon deconstruction.
Fixed issue with incorrect vehicle orientation for vehicles following each other.
Fixed children's animation not stopping upon game pause.
Fixed wounded military running endlessly in the HQ when waiting for a medbay assistance.
Introduced other changes to improve the game's stability.

Important: The medieval wall fix will stop them from generating excessively, but won't delete the medieval walls that were already spawned. The issue shouldn't occur on new games anymore. Please let us know if you encounter this issue in a new game.
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

Another Bugfix Update is here! We fix the issues that you reported the most often and bring a few QoL changes to the game. The Merchant's behavior has now changed, too! Prepare for a short fight if you always attack the Merchant on sight. Be careful!
Added building capacity information in the tooltip when placing a Predefined Building.
Added an option to drag the ammo on the vehicle's ammo bar.
Updated the Merchant behavior. Merchant will now fight back for a brief while when attacked and attempt to run away right after.
Updated the exchange to pause the game.
Fixed the issue with saves made on some maps not working.
Fixed the issue that resulted in the negative ammo. The fix should also correct the incorrect ammunition count for previous saves that encountered this issue.
Fixed the building process that sometimes got stuck towards the end.
Fixed some buildings getting buried deeper in the ground than intended.
Fixed issues with incorrect damage calculations towards the gear equipped by the Squad.
Fixed issues with incorrect swimming animations.
Fixed dragging fuel on the vehicle's fuel bar not working.
Fixed the incorrect door position on the White House building.
Fixed the incorrect camera positions in some rare cases.
Fixed transparent smoke on certain zoom levels.
Fixed issues with the exchange window sometimes closing during the first exchange attempt.
Fixed issue with exceptions sometimes ocurring at sunrise.
Fixed issues with Squads sometimes not fighting the enemies on expeditions.

Thank you for playing Infection Free Zone! Are you excited about the recent changes? Or are you still waiting for some new additions? Let us know how you feel about this newest update. We keep on tracking your feedback and do our best to solve as many issues as we can. Have fun!
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

It’s getting colder outside. It’s the perfect weather to grab a blanket, hide behind your desk, and launch your favorite city-builder game. Defending the Zone against a few waves of Infected is the perfect way to warm up. Have fun with the Bugfix Update #30!
Added new Loading Tips to the game. Different Loading Tips will be displayed depending on the player's progression.
Added resource rewards for finishing Lairs and Hideouts.
Added new Emblems to the Supporter pack.
Added black Emblem background.
Added "Lair/Hideout cleared" mood modifiers.
Decreased the number of children born in the Zone due to the high mood modifier.
Decreased the initial sizes of double and triple Swarms. The difficulty spikes should be lower than before.
Decreased the amount of scientific materials required for researching Vaccines.
Updated the OpenStreetMaps data in the game! You will now find new buildings and other objects that were added to the OSM database in the last 2 years. Works only with new games.
Updated some button tooltips to include more information.
Updated biomes with new building colors.
Updated several Events to avoid situations where the player gets stuck in the storyline.
Updated picking up resources when clicking on the resource icons.

Changed the way the radio chatter voices work. You can also adjust them now in the Settings.
Changed the order of Buildings in the Buildings Menu. Available Buildings are now displayed first on the list.
Updated building generation. Very similar buildings will now have the same shape, which should result in better performance and faster launch of the game.
Updated the number of resources available on Expeditions. Expeditions with 0 or 1 resource shouldn't occur anymore.
Updated Chapter displaying in the mission objectives panel.
Updated "pillaged by Raiders" game over artwork.
Fixed bug with incorrect tooltip for the repair vehicle action.
Fixed bug with heavy machine gun granting acceleration and speed bonus to vehicles.
Fixed bug with citizen numbers going out of the panel when above 999.
Fixed errors when clicking on the right arrow to switch to the next tower.
Fixed an issue that allowed overlapping trees when planting them manually.
Fixed some marker events that weren't disappearing when they were supposed to.
Fixed the event with a bandit attack to not trigger in hideouts and lairs.
Fixed some cases of bridges running under water.
Fixed incorrect water levels on some maps.
Fixed maps with zero buildings being unplayable on Convoys.
Fixed autoinvite freezing the transmission panel if started during a transmission.
Fixed destroyed hideouts being unscavengable after save/load.
Fixed incorrect camera location after game start.
Fixed ruined clay pits from being possible to destroy when canceling them.
Fixed a bug with ammo/resources in the trunk disappearing upon repairing/modifying/deconstructing the Vehicle in the Car Workshop.
Fixed hordes instantly going back to their starting positions upon the Squad exiting the Lair.
Fixed a rare bug with incorrect damage values when fighting with raiders or units hidden in the buildings. Some incorrect logic with Towers was fixed, too.
Fixed bug that prevented the scavenge of a building in repair.
Fixed bug with some hideouts displaying 0 HP before the attack.
Fixed issue with the game sometimes having an incorrect color palette upon loading a game.
Fixed debris spawning underground with the game loaded for the first time.
Fixed bug with enemy vehicles sometimes being visible under the fog of war.
Fixed a bug where some vehicles spawned with an incorrect vertical orientation.
Fixed issue with the Statue being required for the Constructor achievement.
Fixed Squad's input tip disappearing at times.
Fixed clicking on the animal icon not resulting in an attack on the animal.
Fixed Hideouts sometimes counting towards the tutorial shelter mission.
Fixed walls spawning outside of the gameplay area.
Fixed buses sent to convoys changing colors.
Fixed some expedition tiles being unavailable with Vehicles (for example, on the recommended Tromso map).
Fixed bug with Squad in vehicle sometimes shooting despite the lack of ammunition.
Fixed "Create new squad" objective completing upon splitting a Squad.
Fixed camera rotation speed depending on the frame rate. The camera should work better with low performance now.
Fixed the infected being unable to walk on the ice with the "disable swimming infected" option turned on.
Fixed the flow of some events. We will continue observing their stability.
Fixed issues with Car Workshop, empty vehicles, etc.
Fixed some events to avoid situations where the player could get stuck in the storyline.
Fixed issues with vehicle movement on expeditions.
Fixed issue with incorrect heavy machine gun rotation when shooting.
Fixed FPS drops when scrolling through a high number of save files.
Fixed the order of ammo usage when the Squad shoots from a Vehicle. The Vehicle ammo will now be used first.
Fixed infected animals not reacting when attacked by a sniper rifle from full range.
Fixed some lightning issues related to the day/night cycle.
Fixed a bug that prevented players from deconstructing the first HQ after another one had been built.
Fixed issue with follow orders not working with multiple Squads in vehicles, when sent from the same building.
Fixed dragging items from the vehicle trunk to the squad members.
Fixed raiders sometimes exiting buildings to attack their targets when not necessary.
Fixed game over occurring when losing a Squad before setting HQ on a convoy map.
Fixed the order of icons on Expeditions, which sometimes made it hard to select the desired icon.
Fixed the wrong number of workers and incorrect adaptation progress upon loading a game.
Fixed issues with some objects being hard to place after using the Z and X buttons to rotate them.
Fixed certain storyline items that were discardable, which could cause the story to become stuck for some players.
Fixed Squads not running away from the building upon discovering a Lair.
Fixed incorrect field of view for Towers and Gates.
Fixed incorrect enemy spotted radio chatters.
Fixed "Zone attacked!" radio chatter launching when attacking Hideouts.
Fixed "Defences lost!" radio chatter launching when hordes destroy unclaimed walls.
Fixed "Car spotted" radio chatter launching when building a vehicle.
Fixed unavailable buildings placed on Water being available for selecting as HQ.
Fixed "Center View" button not working in the Transmission panel.
Fixed another batch of stability issues to improve the game's performance, save/load system, and reduce the number of crashes.
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

topNew: Added new Loading Tips to the game. Different Loading Tips will be displayed depending on the player's progression.
Added resource rewards for finishing Lairs and Hideouts.
Added new Emblems to the Supporter pack.

items.text: Reducing the crashes and application freezes is the main focus of this update. We have also reduced the pierceability of Hideout buildings to avoid situations where players killed all the Raiders in the building before destroying the building itself. 🛠️
Reduced the chance to hit a Raider inside a Hideout when shooting at a Hideout from 10% to 3%.
Improved the visibility of Area Select during winter.
Fixed a bug with Barbed Wire becoming completely destroyed, instead of having a repairable state.
Fixed a bug with FPS drop in the middle of selecting an area for planting trees.
Fixed a bug with trees being available for planting on farms.
Fixed issue with incorrect emblem material after loading a game.
Introduced another set of stability updates aimed at reducing the number of crashes.
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

Another round of updates is here! Thanks to the incredible feedback from the community, we were able to fix the remaining issue with the assassination event occurring when it shouldn't. Other than that, we keep working on improving the game's stability.
Updated the Triangulation mechanic and added a mission objective that now works with this mechanic.
Updated the Clay Pit building with its own sounds.
Updated the research cost of some research nodes - research costs were lowered.
Updated the young/small trees to provide more resources when cut down. Fully grown trees work the same as they did before.
Updated the Custom Buildings cost and made it lower.
Fixed the assassination occurring in large HQ buildings when the Squad was not kept in the building's center.
Fixed issues with some convoy destinations that had no roads available.
Fixed Mobile HQ missing some metal repair cost.
Fixed ammo bars for Heavy Machine Gun displaying incorrect values.
Fixed two more cases that could've resulted in game crashes.
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

This is one busy week. We have just released the Bugfix Update #26 yesterday, and come back to you with Bugfix Update #27 today! As always, we keep observing your bug reports and feedback and do our best to solve the most critical cases. Have fun!
Added Triangulation research.

Added SetSoldierHp console command. Players can modify the HP of the Squad Members with this command (making them nearly immortal). Quick reminder - it's not recommended to use trainers and similar software. We observe a lot of crashes occurring due to such software.
Updated some flags from the Supporter Pack that had incorrect orientation or lacked the proper vertical design.
Updated the Shotgun research artwork.
Updated some story events. Missing voice-overs were added, and the flow of some quests was improved.
Fixed clicking on hordes on expeditions causing an error.
Fixed an issue where the HQ and some other buildings were not being repaired.
Fixed the Raider storyline objective ending too soon.
Fixed the infected that, in some rare cases, were not hiding in the buildings or underground.
Fixed Squad Icons disappearing when using a CTRL drag-select over a pickup vehicle.
Fixed an option to threaten the Merchant not working.
Fixed some stability issues that could've resulted in crashes.
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

Thank you for all the feedback and reports submitted via the in-game Bug Reporter. We are happy to let you know that the deadly bug with invisible enemies has been fixed. It's also helpful to see all the issues raised in the comments under announcements and in the community discussions. We do our best to read them all and tackle the most popular issues one by one. Thank you for being so patient with us!
Updated NPC Zones and NPC Zone Events.
Updated several events to reduce the possibility of getting stuck during gameplay.
Fixed a bug with invisible enemies.
Fixed some additional cases where the saboteur from the assassination event would spawn in different locations than the largest HQ.
Fixed hideouts having a chance of spawning in demolished buildings.
Fixed some input tips going out of their borders.
Fixed the APC top part not hiding in the fog of war.
Fixed some research artworks being shrunk vertically.

While we keep on working on the next Major Update for you, another Bugfix Update has just been released! It includes some balance changes and introduces the chronological story order once again. After careful observation, we have concluded that the story alteration can significantly increase the game's difficulty without improving replayability in a meaningful way on its own. We have decided to enhance replayability through other features, which we will announce in the future.
Removed Story Alteration. The story now unfolds in chronological order again: Raiders appear first, then Military, then Scientists.

Autocompression for the previous save files has been enabled. You might notice a bar that will show you the progress of the save compression upon loading up the game for the first time after this update. It might take up to a few minutes, depending on the number of your saves.
Improved loading times for the compressed saves.
Fixed an issue that blocked some players from completing the "Up Against the Wall" mission.
Fixed an issue that prevented some players from finding quest markers for labs if the entire Expedition Map had been scavenged beforehand.
Fixed an issue with unoptimized infected dog animations causing lower FPS.
Chance of obtaining a Gun when scavenging a building without a specific POI decreased by 10%.
Chance of obtaining a Shotgun when scavenging a building with a Gun POI increased by 15%.
Chance of obtaining an Assault Rifle when scavenging a building with a Gun POI decreased by 15%.
Shotgun research cost reduced from 15 to 12 Scientific Materials.
Shotgun production time reduced by 9%. Gun and Assault Rifle production times increased by 15% and 10%, respectively.
Raiders armed with Shotguns have been added.
Raider numbers decreased in the early game and increased in the late game to improve the game's difficulty curve.

If you haven't seen it, we have recently released the Major Update #5 Preview - Part I. It mentions some of the new content and features that we are working on for you. We are also happy to let you know that Part II of this preview is coming soon. Expect more news on the next update somewhere in the next two weeks!
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

In the previous bugfix update, we started updating the game's Save System. The autosave logic was updated and now we are taking another step with making the save files smaller and quickly accessible for deletion. Some other popular bugs were fixed, too.
The Save Files compression has been enabled and Map Data is now serialized as bytes. Saves will take less disk space now and should load up faster.
"No Path" red line indicators have been added. Clicking on the building with the No Path icon will show you where the locked Workers are who cannot access your buildings.
A new button has been added to the Emblem Customization panel, which directly opens the corresponding emblem folder.
A new button has been added to the Load Game panel, which directly opens the corresponding save folder. You can now easily delete your older save files.

The maximum angle at which the Vehicle can drive has been changed from 60 degrees to 70 degrees. Some other changes have also been introduced to reduce the risk of the Vehicle getting stuck in Terrain Elevation.
Fixed an issue with Vehicles built/modified in the Car Workshop sometimes spawning vertically on the terrain.
Fixed an issue caused by exchanges with squads that don't exist anymore due to the squad split.
Fixed an issue caused by loading the game instantly after starting the autosave.
Fixed an issue with Squads on expeditions sometimes being impossible to click.
Fixed an issue with Squads sometimes having issues with creating a path to the tile on the expeditions.
Some other most popular exceptions have been fixed.

Regarding the "No Path" red line - when analyzing various cases of inaccessible buildings, we have noticed that most of the time the issue lies with the workers being locked in one of the shelters. We hope that this change will allow you to quickly identify the problem within your Zone and remove the obstacles that are blocking your workers from leaving their positions.

We plan to launch a small contest this week. Expect more details in the upcoming announcement. Then, in the second part of August, we want to show you the Major Update #5 preview, showcasing all the exciting content coming to Infection Free Zone. Do you have any predictions regarding what's coming next? Stay tuned for more info soon!
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

While most of the team works on new content, we are also still looking into the most common issues that you report our way. We introduce some changes to the autosaves in this update, but our aim is to make the saves smaller in the future, too. Thank you for all your reports and feedback!
The "Limit Autosave Files" option has been enabled by default when launching the game for the first time or when resetting the settings to default.

Fixed an issue with the merchant staying in the Zone after choosing the "Show me what you've got" option.

Fixed an issue with Vehicles sometimes getting stuck in the buildings and in the terrain.

We receive many questions about the new content for Infection Free Zone. A new batch of updates has been released! Reducing the number of crashes and freezes, especially during autosaves and while generating a new map, was our highest priority. We have also introduced a change that should help the players who were unable to play the game on GeForce Now. Several other improvements have also been introduced, and we hope that they will positively impact your gameplay.

The construction materials required for Custom Buildings have been rebalanced. Some materials now only require 1 type of resource, instead of various kinds of resources with their volume as the only difference. This should make the custom buildings more accessible for the players.
A new solution has been introduced for markers spawning outside antenna range. It might not work on the existing saves.

A new "ILLNESS EVENTS" checkbox has been added in the Game Customization panel. You can now disable all the illness events and ensure that vaccines won't have to be researched in your Zone. This checkbox is only available with the "STORY EVENTS" checkbox turned off.
Some console commands have been updated. We have disabled the usage of some parameters that could have caused errors.
Some console commands have been "unlocked" and are now available without the usage of the "Enable Cheats" command first.
Metal will now spawn as a scavengable resource in some industrial buildings.
Discarding cans will now provide the player with a small amount of metal.
A new warning is displayed when the game detects that the player is using modding software.
The save system has been updated and will first save in the Temp folder to prevent the possibility of losing the save.
An issue with Squads leaving resources in buildings during scavenging and not coming back for them has been fixed.
An issue with Squads parking Vehicles outside Medieval Walls when coming back with resources has been fixed.
An issue with Polearms not being treated as weapons during the ransom event has been fixed.
An issue with workers sometimes having square shadows on a certain zoom-out has been fixed.
An issue that could have resulted in the game crashing during the autosave has been fixed.
An issue that could have resulted in the game not working on the GeForce NOW has been fixed.
An issue with the captured Squad participating in the fight during the ransom event has been fixed.
An issue that resulted in the camera zooming in when using the TAB and H buttons has been fixed.
Several changes aimed at optimizing the game and reducing the number of crashes have been introduced.

We have recently noticed that some players are having issues with the game due to the usage of modding software. Such software is never recommended on our side. The risk of crashing or corrupting your gameplay is high, and the safety of those applications is not guaranteed. Instead, we encourage the usage of the console commands. A new manual has been published to make them easier to understand.
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

We hope that your experience with the game will improve after this update. If you encounter any bugs, please use the Bug Reporter available in the ESC Menu to let us know about your issue. We will also be happy to read your feedback about the state of the game in the comments. Have fun!
A number of performance updates have been introduced to reduce the possibility of the game crashing during the loading screen, auto-saves, and in other situations.
The Terrain Elevation checkbox in the Game Customization panel is now enabled by default.
The Vaccine's Research has been updated to inform the players more clearly when new research is available.
The "meat" icons on wild animals have been replaced with their own corresponding icons.

The distance between the trees planted by the Forester has been increased.
Input tips have been redesigned to display in two rows. The text trimming has been removed.
New Credits animations have been added.
The Map Search Engine has been updated to suggest the recommended maps when searching for the map from the recommended list.
New pop-up warnings have been added when the player is starting/loading/saving a game with insufficient RAM.

An issue with one of the merchant's dialogue options causing the game to freeze has been fixed.
An issue with immigrants killing ransom bandits causing the storyline lock has been fixed.
An issue with the squad creation timer resetting after save/load has been fixed.
An issue with some bridges and roads displaying under water with the terrain elevation turned off has been fixed.
An issue with the Supermoon event oftentimes occurring exactly on the 3rd day has been fixed.
An issue with the Squad sometimes not entering the correct building when clicking on the side of the building has been fixed.
An issue with Barbed Wire being stackable, allowing to place one on top of another, has been fixed.
An issue with resources being blurry on zoom-out has been fixed.
An issue with some infected not hiding properly during low FPS gameplay has been fixed.

Jutsu Games Team

We are pleased to deliver another important batch of fixes - v0.24.8.7 11 BETA is now available at the default branch - make sure you update the game!
First of all, we changed our entire compilation infrastructure, to build a more stable game that will work much more smoothly and crash less often.
However, we have an important message to all 3% of you who try to use integrated graphics cards:

Infection Free Zone cannot work properly with integrated graphics cards. The game is simply too complex, there are usually way too many dynamic 3D objects and the pathfinding grid is too large for the older generation of machines. IFZ might look aesthetically old-school, but it is actually extremely computation-heavy.
The HPs of the adapted buildings have been increased based on their size.
The amount of hordes, immigrants, and bandits that we encounter will now be affected by the total volume of the buildings on the map, rather than the total number of buildings on the map.
Beverages now need 2x less grain

An issue with the barn event not appearing for some players has been fixed.

An issue with some maps crashing after launch has been fixed.
An issue with some buildings losing mouseover highlights has been fixed.

An issue with the vehicle icon disappearing after loading a game has been fixed.

An issue that prevented an exchange with a broken vehicle has been fixed.

An issue with the game freezing when picking up the resources from the ground has been fixed,
An issue with scroll in warehouses not working when having more than two lines of resources has been fixed,

We are doing our best to provide you with another Update as fast as possible. Thank you for playing Infection Free Zone's Early Access. Your feedback and support are extremely appreciated!
Please use internal Bug Reporter (available in ESC menu) to let us know about any issues that you encounter - this is the best way to send us broken savegame files, the logs, specs, etc!

Jutsu Games Team

The Major Update #6 is finally here! We are extremely excited to bring this huge chunk of new content and features to all the players. Everyone should find something interesting in this update, whether it's the new priority system, the tanks and mortars, or the bloomery to produce metal, because they were always running out of this one specific resource.
If you need a quick rundown of the most important additions in this update, check the Trailer below!

After analyzing the feedback from the open beta branch, we can see that there is a group of players who still prefer the old priority system. That's a perfectly valid approach! If you would rather change to the old priority system, go to the Settings and change the "Workers Management" to "Manual":

Of course, we still heavily encourage you to check the new Priority System. While you might need some time to get adjusted to it, it should take away most of your problems with micromanaging the workers. Just take some time to experiment with new priorities. Don't make works that are too big when not necessary and use all the priorities (including the middle one as a base) to get the most out of this system.

As mentioned in the previous announcements, older saves won't be supported in this Update. If you still want to continue playing your old save, you have to change the branch on Steam and switch to the previous Update:
Right-click on Infection Free Zone in your Steam Library.
Select "Properties..."
Go to the "Game Versions & Betas" tab.
Select "old_major_update_5" to continue playing on your old save.
In recent days, some open beta players have asked, so we also want to clarify - after the full release of the game, we don't plan to do any more save wipes of this sort.

Added a new Priority System for the Workers.
Added new buildings - Bloomery (obtaining metal), Cemetery, Crematorium, Explosives Factory.
Added a new Tank vehicle.
Added new weapon - Mortar.

Added new events, mostly related to Laws.
Added a new Building Demolition feature.
Added a new Item Lock feature. Locked items won't be left at the warehouse.
Added a new Alarm feature.
Added new Squad Patrolling feature. Click on one of the previous points with the Order Queue to create a loop.
Added a new Squad Move Together feature. Select multiple Squads that are close together to make them move with the same speed as the slowest selected unit.
Added a new Friendly Fire feature, which can result in your units hurting each other when using Explosives. Friendly Fire can be turned off.

Added a set of new Console Commands (FastConstructionState, InfiniteAmmoState, FastResearchState, FastScavengeState, PerfectMoodState, FreeResearchState, NoHungerState, PerfectWeatherState, SetBuildingCapacity, AddSkillToGroup).
Added a new Camera Setting and updated the maximum Camera Zoom Out distance. Mind you, you can still switch to the Old Camera via Settings.
Added new Dynamic Settings that will adjust based on the game's performance.
Added new resources - Vaccines and Beverages.
Added a new Apply to All option for the buildings. Clicking with SHIFT will cause the same action to be repeated for every building of the same type in the Zone.
Added an option to choose another destination with the Bus HQ.

Added an option to repair/claim neutral defensive structures like Medieval Walls or Sound Barriers.
Added new map decorations from the Open Street Map based on the landusage tag.
Added a new survey to the Main Menu (we will be thankful for doing them!).

items.text: Another huge update has just been released! This time we have focused on improving the game's performance and adding several new features to the game.

With Indoor Movement you can now move inside the buildings and defend large objects that previously caused problems. New Perks can be acquired by your squad members while participating in specific actions like driving, fighting, or scavenging. Vehicle scavenging has been reworked accordingly to your requests. Now the squad will be associated with the vehicle and move with it from building to building. And that's just the beginning! Check the full list of changes below!
Indoor Movement has been added to the game, allowing the squads to pass through buildings or go to a specific place in large buildings.
A new squad member's Skill System has been added to the game.
Vehicle Scavenging has been reworked, allowing the squads to be permanently assigned to a vehicle.
Map Info Panel has been added to the game.
A "Repair All" button has been added to adapted buildings and structures. Clicking on this button will order repair work on all the buildings/structures of the same type.
A new Polearm weapon has been added. Polearms deal more damage than the default Machetes, have a higher range, and can be found in Museums or produced.
The HP of Wood and Metal Walls has been increased by 50%.
The HP of Brick and Fortified Walls has been increased by 25%.
Kindergarten building and Kindergarten related mood modifiers have been added,
Bar building and Bar related mood modifiers have been added.
Current Game Customization has been added to the Escape Menu. Now you can adjust your game's difficulty without starting a new game.
Workers' logic behind production and resource transportation has been improved to ensure higher work effectiveness.
Gear Production and its corresponding researches and buildings have been added to the game.
New Gear models for Squad Members have been added to the game.
A new Mood visualization, which also informs about the current Mood trending tendency, has been added.
Double tapping on the hotkey assigned to a specific squad by the player (CTRL+number) will now move the camera to this group.
SUV and Compact Car Vehicles have been added to the game.
Icons with the HP for walls, towers, and gates are now displayed if their HP is lower than 100%.
Research has been rebalanced. The researches available further in the Research Tree require more Scientific Materials and time now.
A new Daytime Music Theme has been added.
Plate Armor has been rebalanced and is now causing -20% movement speed for the squad.
A new recommended map has been added to the game - Washington.
A new Low Memory Warning has been added to the game to inform the player when the game might be about to crash due to insufficient memory.
An ability to deadapt HQs (while having more than one) has been added.
The possible difference in strength between the following swarms of infected has been reduced.
The biomes in South Korea and North Korea have been updated to include Korean names.
Edge Scrolling Checkbox has been added to the Settings.
New hotkeys have been added for actions like Repair, Repair All, Deadapt, Deconstruct, Cancel,
Replenish, Exchange, Split, Go to HQ, Disband, and for changing stances.
The barn and fertilizers have been rebalanced to reduce their impact on food production.
All the new content has been translated into supported languages.
An issue with corrupted saves caused by pausing the game and instantly adapting buildings in deconstruction/repair has been fixed.
An issue that caused some units to get stuck on the corners of buildings has been fixed.
An issue that sometimes caused the hordes to stay in buildings during the day has been fixed.
An issue with some events not starting has been fixed.
An issue that affected the line of sight of some towers and gates has been fixed.
An issue with vehicles sometimes not responding to input has been fixed.
An issue that caused some infected not to get pushed by the vehicle has been fixed.
An issue with bug reports not going through due to large size has been fixed.
An issue with an expedition mission not completing upon reaching its marker has been fixed.
An issue that caused the hordes to sometimes focus on structures, instead of the squads, has been fixed.
An issue with some achievements tracking progress across all save files instead of one specific game has been fixed.
An issue with the Alpha Infected not burying underground has been fixed.
An issue with the Alpha Infected having incorrect movement speed parameters has been fixed.
An issue with buried infected being sometimes visible has been fixed.
An issue that caused the smoke particles to render inside the buildings has been fixed.
An issue with some animations not launching properly has been fixed.
An issue with the bandits dealing higher damage than intended, has been fixed.
An issue that resulted in the squads not returning to the nearest HQ has been fixed.
An issue with the squad list scrollbar having very low sensitivity has been fixed.
An issue with partial adaptation not being visible during the winter nights has been fixed.
A new set of optimization changes has been introduced to improve the average FPS during gameplay.

First of all, we will be focusing on double-checking that all the recent changes are working correctly. If needed, a bug fix might come in the next few days. After that, we will start working on the next Major Update, which will include... A new storyline! As usual, you can also expect some new features, but we know that many of you are waiting for the new chunks of the story!
Thank you, everyone, for your ongoing support! We keep on working on Infection Free Zone to bring you the best experience possible!
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

items.text: Finally, the new Major Update #5 is now available for everyone to play! Huge thank you to all the players who have helped us and played this update on the open_beta branch. Your feedback and all the bug reports were priceless! Of course, we will keep on observing the stability of this build. Expect necessary bug fixes in the upcoming weeks.
Added New Storyline. Have fun exploring the newest events in Infection Free Zone!
Added 5x5 Maps. Expect longer loading times when selecting 5x5 maps.
Added Laws and the corresponding Gathering Place building. You have to reach 200 citizens to unlock the Gathering Place, which allows you to change the Laws within the Zone.
Added Predefined Buildings.
Added the Clay Pit building. You can produce bricks in the Clay Pit.
Added Lairs of the Infected spawning on the map.
Added the Raider Hideouts spawning on the map.

Updated Infected Hordes' logic. While some Infected will still roam throughout the Zone, most Infected will now stay in the vicinity of their Lair. This change doesn't impact the behavior of Swarms in any way.
Added Convoys and the Zone Migration. Destroy Lairs, Hideouts, and finish the new Storyline to unlock the option to start anew at a distant location.
Added Heavy Machine Gun Vehicle modification. The corresponding research has to be unlocked first.
Added 10 new Research Nodes. They are mostly focused on providing the player with different bonuses towards production time, wall HP, etc.
Added Squad Drag-select. You can now drag-select multiple squads while pressing the CTRL button.
Updated the More Settings section in Game Customization. With the Story Mode disabled, you can now adjust:
Starting month,
Full day length (in minutes),
Population limit (up to 2000),
Swimming Infected (on/off),
Infected animals (on/off),
Lairs (on/off),
Hideouts(on/off),
Swarm Intensity,
Full moons (on/off),
Blackout storms,
Day to night ratio.
Added the translations for the newest Major Update.
New Walls and Barriers have been added to maps, based on their real data from Open Street Maps.
Some recommended maps were updated with new details, colors, and other changes.
ESC button will now make you go back when navigating Main Menu, Credits, Settings, Load Game, City Selector, Tile Selector, and some other screens.
Raw Meat will now spoil over time.
Bus stops, Street Signs, Windmills, Tunnels (non-enterable), and a few other map decorations have been added to the game.
Graffiti decorations have been added to some buildings.
Beach (sand) terrain decoration has been added to the game.
Tooltips for different resources have been updated to display more information about the player's economy.
Building-Split visualization has been updated.
Starting Keybind mappings for enabling Scavenge View and enabling/disabling Building outlines have been removed. They can be set up again via the Settings menu.
New "auto-pause" Settings have been added. Players can decide now when the game should pause and when it should not.
Forced auto-snapping has been added for walls in cases where the gaps between the walls are very small.
An option to claim the walls from the map's environment has been added.
Added visual indication in the weather panel for months with Blackout storm and Full Moon.
Added a tooltip informing about the reason the structure building is blocked.
Added Statistics panel to the ESC Menu.
Improved enemy shooting mechanics from vehicles. Enemies shouldn't be able to shoot and drive at the same time anymore.
Improved vehicle pathing to avoid situations where vehicles took a longer route when not necessary.
Updated the logic behind the Rain transitions (Rain into Storm).
Updated the behavior of workers running away.
Multiple events have been updated to avoid the situation where some of them could get stuck.
Multiple optimization changes have been introduced to reduce the number of crashes and improve the game's performance and loading times.
Added NPC Zones. You can now encounter different types of Zones on expeditions that will differ from each other.
Added the Tromso recommended map.
Added new achievements.
The amount of resources carried by a single worker at once has been changed from 1 to 2.
Vehicle construction, deconstruction, repair times, and repair costs have been decreased.
The Cistern Vehicle maximum space for Fuel has been increased from 20 to 40, and resource capacity from 4 to 6.
Weapon damage has been adjusted depending on the range at which we are shooting. Some weapons will now be more or less effective, depending on the distance from the enemy.
Double and Triple Swarms have been added. You can expect more hordes attacking your Zone at later points in the game.
Increased chance for Megastorm, which was nonexistent in some locations.
Fixed an issue with hordes sometimes stacking in one place and stopping from moving further.
Fixed an issue with time speed affecting time-to-kill for Squads.
Fixed an issue with building construction not ending at times.
Fixed an issue with vehicles sometimes getting stuck in buildings.
Fixed an issue with vehicles sometimes being able to ride over very steep slopes.
Fixed an issue with the animal death animation sometimes not playing.
Fixed an issue with vehicles sometimes instantly turning back.
Fixed an issue with vehicles sometimes stopping for a short while when selecting a new direction.
Fixed an issue that occurred during exchange with an empty squad.
Fixed an issue with the Squads panel displaying an incorrect number of ammo on different Squads.
Fixed an issue that occurred when workers were attacked by enemy units.
Fixed an issue with some animals not having swimming animations.
Fixed an issue where water had incorrect depth levels.
Fixed an issue with the incorrect position of a car after construction.
Fixed an issue with trees being possible to be planted in the adapted buildings.
Fixed an issue with vehicles sometimes using fuel when not driving.
Fixed an issue with citizens sometimes starving despite a warehouse full of food.
Fixed an issue with building/structure outlines displaying over vehicles.
Fixed an issue with normal hordes having infected dog icons.
Fixed an issue with rain disappearing after save/load.
Fixed gates missing the green fill.
Fixed an issue with infected not attacking Clay Pits or Fisherman buildings.
Fixed an issue with some tooltips not disappearing as intended.
Fixed issue with water having irregular shapes in some places.
Fixed the merchant and the cases where he was visiting the Zone every day.

The Supporter Pack is launching today, too! This DLC Package helps finance the production of Infection Free Zone. It's not mandatory to play the Infection Free Zone and offers only cosmetic and out-of-game items. Still, we hope that the content of the Supporter Pack will bring joy to our most dedicated fans. Thank you for being with us!
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team
P.S. There's also a new Survey in the game! All the responses will be appreciated, as they make our development vastly easier.

We are super happy to let you know that a new Major Update is available on the Default branch of the game! At first, our initial focus after the launch was to solve as many bugs and stability issues as possible. After a few updates, we reached a point where the number of stability and bug reports decreased by 90%. Instead, numerous requests for new functionalities and content began to appear.
In this Major Update, we want to meet those expectations. We are adding several new systems and hope that they improve your overall experience with Infection Free Zone. Have fun!
Gear System has been added to the game, including Sport Protector, Riot Gear and Plate Armor. Those will allow extra protection for your squad members.
Two new types of POI have been added - Museums and Sports Shops where you can find the Gear.

Emblem customization has been added. Now you can both change your zone's name and its emblem. It's also possible to upload custom images to the Infection Free Zone_Data\StreamingAssets\Emblem\Logo folder and use them as emblems in the game.
A tree regrowth system has been added. The trees will grow back by themself now.
Greenhouses have been added to the game. They cost 4 wood, 8 metal, and 1 tool to build, but are immune to negative modifiers from the weather.

The Citizen Reproduction System has been added. When specific conditions are met (enough food, available housing, proper mood level), children will appear in the Zone. Children consume 50% as much as adults, use the house/shelter living slots, and take 12 in-game days to grow up.
A resource discard feature has been added (right-click on the resource in your storage to discard the resources).
Additional entrances have been added to the buildings to improve the overall scavenging experience.
A new Megastorm and Supermoon music themes have been added.
The Citizen Housing logic has been reworked. The citizens will now get back to sleep at the closest shelter/house, which should help with running outposts.
The Building System has been improved to allow structures to be placed on gatherable objects. The workers will remove the gatherable object first and then proceed with the original task.
POI Filters have been added to the View Layers section. Players can now look for specific POIs like guns or gear on the map.
Heavy Rain animation for the Megastorm event has been added.
New shrub models have been added to the game.
Damaged structure models have been added to the game,
Snow particles and snow animation have been updated.
Beijing Map has been updated.
Mast visuals have been updated.

It is now possible to select an empty production cycle in the Medbay building to keep on attending to the wounded in the beds but refrain from manufacturing unwanted first aid kits. The UI of this solution will receive an update in the future.
The day/night length has been increased by 20%.
Default Warehouse capacity has been increased by 20%.
The number of potential immigrants wandering around our Zone has been slightly increased.
The Globetrotter achievement logic has been updated.
Hordes will now attack the encountered farm crops. Farms won't get destroyed, but the production progress will go down.
Biome regions have been updated to fix issues with excessively low temperatures in some areas.

The Assault Rifle base damage has been decreased by around 50%, but the attack speed has been vastly increased. This should result in the weapon being very strong, but consuming significant amounts of ammo.
The Shotgun base damage has been increased by around 25%. The attack speed has been slightly decreased.
The Shotguns have been added to the pool of scavengable items in the game.
The maximum available angle when placing walls has been increased.
The maximum available camera zoom-in has been increased.
The camera angle change during zoom-in and zoom-out has been readjusted.
The density of trees has been increased.
An issue with tooltips displaying incorrect information for buildings that are unlocked by multiple technologies has been fixed.
An issue with hordes attacking structures resetting their position upon death of one of the infected has been fixed.
An issue with the military medbay storyline causing errors has been fixed.
An issue with non-infected NPC groups attacking Infected who were buried down has been fixed.
An issue that caused the Research Tree to not properly refresh all the available researches has been fixed.
An issue with errors happening with partially adapted buildings getting fully adapted has been fixed.
Issues that were caused by the Zone name not having a character limit have been fixed. Now the maximum character limit for the Zone name is 32 characters.
A number of other minor issues have been fixed.

We hope that you will enjoy all the recent changes. Have fun and let us know about your feedback in the comments! Would you like us to work further on the current systems? Or should we prioritize completely new functionalities? We're all ears!
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

The time has come! A new update for Infection Free Zone is now available on Steam and we cannot wait to see your feedback! We are introducing some huge, new features, and one that was probably the hardest to implement in the history of Infection Free Zone so far - the terrain elevation. We have also been constantly verifying your feedback. That's why some significant balance changes are present in this update too. As you may notice, we haven't been able to introduce the Lairs yet. This feature is planned for release during the next update. Let's check all the changes in the newest version!
Terrain Elevation and 3D Roads have been added (enable it via checkbox in Game Customization).
Edinburgh and San Francisco have been added as built-in maps. Those maps are recommended to try the Terrain Elevation.
Merchant and Trading Events have been added.
A Car Workshop building (with Car Construction/Modification/Deconstruction) has been added.
Tree Planting area work has been added,
Forrester Hut building has been added. Workers assigned to this building will plant trees nearby automatically.
Sawmill building has been added. Workers assigned to this building will cut down the nearby trees automatically.
Huntable Animals - Boars and Deer have been added. Huntable animals drop Raw Meat for further processing in the Cookhouse
Infected Animals - Cattle, Moose, and Bears have been added as a serious threat. Check if your chosen map can spawn them, as they do not appear in every location.
Story Alteration (different storylines can occur first) has been added.
The amount of ammunition that can be stored in Pistol, Shotgun, and Sniper Rifle weapons has been increased to 200.
The amount of ammunition in 1 crate has been increased from 100 to 200 ammo.
The amount of ammunition crates that can be found during scavenging has been decreased accordingly.
Building Fortification has been rebalanced and is now 3 times longer when increasing the Building's HP. The Building HP acquired from Fortification has been increased from +30% to +50%.
The Sniper Rifle has been rebalanced and now requires 2 ammo per shot. The cooldown between the shots has been increased from 3.3s to 3.66s.

Squad members' skill acquisition has been rebalanced. The squads now get x2 more exp for fighting skills from killing infected enemies and x1.3 more exp for driving skills from driving. They also get x4 less exp for scavenging skills from scavenging. This should help avoid a situation where most squads have scavenging-related skills.
The HP for all Wall types has been increased by 50%.
The Mood drop time has been increased to avoid the situations where players have instant issues when trying to repair shelters or other important social buildings.
The amount of gatherable metal from different objects on the map has been increased by 12%-50%, depending on the object.
The amount of secondary resources obtainable from deconstruction has been increased. In most cases, this will result in fewer bricks and more metal and wood from deconstruction.
Vehicle wreck spawning has been updated and there should be more of them next to the roads.

Overall, we believe that the issues with the insufficient amounts of wood should be fully fixed now. The amount of metal resource should also be significantly higher in this build. We will keep on tracking the data and feedback from the players to decide on the next changes in regards to metal acquisition.
New events about people wanting to join our Zone have been added. Different groups of immigrants will now appear, each with their own characteristics.
New animal-related events have been added.
Squad Creation has been reworked and now takes 3 in-game hours. Remember about recruiting squads in advance!
The Building roof type algorithm has been updated. There should be fewer buildings with flat roofs overall.
The New Recommended Cities are now visible at the top of the list. The "Downloaded" section will adjust its size depending on the number of downloaded cities.
An option to download the Google Maps' satellite images for the map background has been added in the Settings.
New research has been added to the Technology Tree.
The research cost of some technologies in the Infection tree has been decreased.
The "Symptomatic Treatment" research has been updated to include the information about the number of days required to treat the citizen.
The number of workers required to adapt the Kindergarten building has been decreased.
The Map Info Panel has been updated with more data about the specifications of the selected location.
A new "Unsupported Save" pop-up has been added. While your old saves should still be playable, we recommend starting a new game on this build.
An issue that allowed duplicating items by dropping them in the buildings has been fixed.
An issue with grass overgrowing roads too much has been fixed.
An issue with Infected being capable of dealing damage to squads in vehicles has been fixed.
An issue with custom buildings being hard to place due to the "lines cannot intersect" error has been fixed.
An issue that Custom Building entrances changing location after save/load has been fixed.
An issue that allowed placing walls inside buildings has been fixed.
An issue with Squads not scavenging buildings when clicking on the POI icon has been fixed.
An issue with squads sometimes getting stuck at the building's entrance has been fixed.
An issue with infected leaving buildings for a brief moment when spawned has been fixed.
An issue with vaccine research resetting overnight has been fixed.
An issue with deconstructed/destroyed medieval walls reappearing after save/load has been fixed.
An issue with the game becoming unresponsive when trying to discard less than 1 resource has been fixed.
An issue with ESC button not opening the ESC Menu when more than one squad was selected has been fixed.
An issue with missing Vehicles on expeditions has been fixed.
Performance and stability improvements have been introduced to increase your FPS and reduce the amount of crashes.

Let us know how you feel about all the recent changes! If you encounter any issues, please report them via in-game Bug Reporter, available under the ESC Menu. This will provide us with necessary logs which make solving the reported issues way easier. Thank you for playing Infection Free Zone! We hope that you will have a great time with Major Update 4!
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

items.text: The newest update is finally here! We are extremely thankful to all the early participants who were sharing their feedback with us, based on their open_beta branch experience. This update is focused on bringing you the features that were requested the most often. We hope that they will make the game more enjoyable for you and remove some of the unnecessary micromanagement. Want to know more? Check all the details below!
A new Scientist Storyline has been added.
Illness and vaccine mechanics have been added.
An area Scavenge feature has been added. Drag-select over an area to add multiple buildings to the scavenging queue instantly.
Custom Building construction has been added.
Building Customization and Fortification have been added.
Repairmen Shop building has been added. Repairmen will automatically repair buildings in your Zone.
Stop-to-shoot logic for the Squads has been added. Squads will react to the nearby threat to defend themselves.

It's 2024 and we are back and working on the game in full swing! We are happy to let you know about the first development update this year. Several things are changing and we are eager to know your feedback on them.

notes.title: List of changes in the recent update

items.text: The horde spawner has been reworked. Now, the player should encounter a higher number of hordes on average. This number will also adjust to some extent, depending on how well is the player doing overall.
The range of pistol weapons has been slightly reduced.

Fighting the hordes in the buildings has been rebalanced. The hordes will now start dealing damage faster, preventing the "bouncing" strategy, where some players leave the buildings and enter repeatedly to avoid receiving damage.
An issue with horde swarms not appearing for players at night has been fixed. This fix won't work for previous saves and will require the players to start a new gameplay.
"Fire at will" and "Move at will" Squad Stances have been added. Disabling them should help prevent situations where squads partake in risky actions like leaving the buildings at night.
An option to disable the "Tutorial" events has been added.
Atlanta - a new recommended map has been added.
New sound effects and a new battle theme have been added during the night.
New Chinese maps have been generated with the help of image recognition technology for places that had missing data in OpenStreetMap database.
Number of small bug fixes and optimization changes.

With this update, we wanted to address the issue of the game getting stagnant for some testers and early backers, who were able to develop their Zones well enough. The game should now impose a bigger threat on the player while taking into account several factors, like the number of resources the player currently has.

We plan to observe the results of those changes and react accordingly. Our main goal here is to ensure that the player can continue playing after the initial events for many days and still have fun, encountering new challenges and overcoming them. While this task might require many iterations on our side, we hope that this will be a good starting point.
Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team
